{{Quote|Don't leave me&hellip;|O.M.5's last words|<ref name="Legacy of Terror" />}}
'''O.M.5''', also known as '''OM 5''', was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], serving under [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]].

==Biography==
During the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]], he escorted Poggle the Lesser's [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]] with two other [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and two winged [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Warrior caste (Geonosian)/Legends|warriors]]. After losing a munitions crate, O.M.5 and another [[Unidentified B1 battle droid (O.M.5)/Legends|battle droid]] began marching behind Poggle's tank. They were caught up in a sandstorm, and were unable to see each other. O.M.5. then fell into the ground as the wind blew harder, and as his remaining fellow droid and Lord Poggle continued to the [[Progate Temple/Legends|Progate Temple]], O.M.5. tried telling them to not leave him behind. They continued ahead, unable to hear him and determined to reach their destination before [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] caught up to them. He then stopped functioning and was buried by the storm, Unduli and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Buzz/Legends|Buzz]] passing over his body on their [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeders]].<ref name="Legacy of Terror" />

==Characteristics==
O.M.5 expressed desire not to be left behind just as he deactivated.<ref name="Legacy of Terror" />

==Behind the scenes==
O.M.5, like every battle droid in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''The Clone Wars'' movie]] and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]], was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]]. The name O.M.5 was re-used for another battle droid in the episode "[[Supply Lines]]."
